name: red-4-final-race
purpose: U005 RED on the FINAL tests against the naive specimen, mode race (replay of red-1 on the final test files)

notOk: a list adapter that throws synchronously is rejected through the race, and the timer is cleared
a new root that cannot be recorded is listed as unverifiable with its refusal code, never dropped
F3: a sleep that never settles cannot hang terminate; the outer race reports the survivor and the timeout
F3: a defect inside the core is reported as an error and every entry as a survivor, not thrown
F9: terminate rejects invalid deadlines before it reads or kills anything
F4: a lying kill that lands exactly on the deadline is still not terminated
F10 limit: a process the caller itself starts while the open runs cannot be told apart and is recorded as new
F1: an empty process table fails closed, never success-shaped
F1: a truncated table without the caller fails closed, one with the caller is accepted
F1: terminating over an empty table reports nothing gone and nothing terminated
helper rows: the helper that printed the table is not a new child, a stranger with that pid is kept
F2: an unreadable descendant and everything below it is listed as unverifiable, not dropped
F2: the owned tree counts an unverifiable descendant against clean while it is listed, not once it is gone
F3: a list adapter that never settles is raced against its deadline and the timer is cleared
F3: a kill adapter that never settles cannot hang terminate, nothing is claimed
F3: a list adapter that never settles cannot hang terminate either
F4: terminated is claimed only after a confirming fresh table, otherwise it is unconfirmed
a real kill is confirmed by the table: terminated, clean, and history keeps terminated over alreadyGone
F5: ownerPid is required, a foreign owner, a foreign root, system pids and the caller are refused
F5: the caller and system pids are never forwarded to the kill adapter
F5: an all-protected batch reaches no adapter at all and a bogus outcome list is ignored
F9: timers are capped at 2147483647 ms and invalid deadlines are rejected
F8: process.env itself reaches the Windows adapters and a plain copy with other casing works too
the real Windows adapters record their helper pid so the helper never looks like a new child
the owned tree records exactly the new children of the caller, not the baseline, and replaces a reused pid
a new direct child with an unreadable creation time is unverifiable, a protected one is refused, nothing throws
a protected or unverifiable refusal that is still listed is not clean
expiry during launch ends only the owned tree and rejects with a typed error
expiry during new context ends only the owned tree and rejects with a typed error
expiry during new page ends only the owned tree and rejects with a typed error
expiry during navigation ends only the owned tree and rejects with a typed error
expiry before any child exists rejects at once and keeps watching; a late browser and a late session are cleaned
a session that resolves late, after its tree was ended at expiry, is closed and never left behind
a late session whose close fails is reported, not hidden, and is not clean
a late session whose close never settles is abandoned after the grace period and its tree is still ended
an open that never settles and spawns nothing is abandoned after the grace period and reported unclean
a browser that cannot be ended is reported as survived: never success-shaped
an access-denied browser process is listed as failed and survived
F4 at startup: a kill adapter that lies about a kill cannot produce terminated
F3 at startup: a list adapter that stops answering still lets the rejection arrive, unclean
F3 at startup: a kill adapter that never settles still lets the rejection arrive, with survivors
F1 at startup: an empty table at expiry is never read as everything gone
F2 at startup: an unreadable descendant is listed as unverifiable and counted until it is gone
pid reuse between snapshot and kill: the stranger is refused, never killed, and survives
a startup inside the deadline returns the session with the owned tree and kills nothing
an opener that throws synchronously is treated like a rejection and is still swept for leftovers
an open that fails but leaves a browser behind is swept by identity and reported
a session without a new child process of the caller is closed and refused, never returned unowned
a session whose process table cannot be read after the open is closed and refused
a process table that cannot be read before the open fails closed before anything is launched
F9 at startup: deadlines are validated before the lock or the opener are touched and capped at 2147483647 ms
two concurrent startups are serialised and each records only its own browser
the default lock is shared per process and a call after a timeout works once the first cleanup ended
the phase is unknown when the opener cannot report one, and the error shape is stable
an abort signal ends the owned tree like an expiry and rejects with ERR_STARTUP_ABORTED
a signal that is already aborted launches nothing and reads nothing
an abort after the session was returned changes nothing, and an invalid signal is refused up front
a phase probe that throws cannot mask the cleanup: the phase is unknown
a timer that breaks while watching ends the watch with an unclean final outcome and still frees the lock
an open abandoned after the grace period has its late session closed, and only its own
